queries_run: Mueller Water Products distribution channel shift 2026
Mueller Water Products business model transition subscription OR platform smart water 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K：公司主要仍賣給美加全國與區域性水務經銷商，經銷關係非排他、無長期合約，前兩大經銷商占毛銷售約37%（2025）、38%（2024）、35%（2023）；一手文件未見通路轉為直銷或D2C。
findings.excerpt: We primarily sell to national and regional waterworks distributors in the United States and Canada. Our distributor relationships are generally non-exclusive, but we attempt to align ourselves with key distributors in the principal markets we serve.

findings.claim: 2026-11-04 公司宣布退出計量（metering）業務，客戶移轉給 ZENNER USA；預期年化調整後EBITDA利潤率增加100–140bp，主要自FY2027 Q2起，FY2027一次性費用約2,600萬美元。屬產品線／商業模式縮減，非通路改變。
findings.source: Mueller Water Products 8-K 新聞稿（Exhibit 99.2）／Finviz 新聞
findings.excerpt: Under the agreement, Mueller is exiting the metering business and will transition customers to ZENNER USA for replacement software and hardware to continue to fulfill our customer commitments.

channel_business_model_shift.note: 搜尋未見訂閱化／D2C／平台化的結構性通路轉變證據；Sentryx軟體平台存在但未查到2026年經常性收入揭露。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
